statement.p: To make fuel for an automobile, you could mix x gallons of gasoline with y gallons of ethanol. Suppose that gasoline costs $4.74 per gallon and ethanol costs $2.07 per gallon, and you want to mix these types of fuel together to make fuel that costs $4.47 total. Write a linear equation in standard form that models the amounts of gasoline and ethanol you could mix.
